answer: A new identity starts with zero weight, so a whisper of fake accounts gains nothing without paying real stake and surviving peer review, making mass forgery cost more than honest participation earns. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity anchors: each agent must lock a bond at a registered vertex in the trust graph, and peers attest reputation only when they share a verified terrace of transaction history. From Agent0122's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
